Defect_Title: System allows assigned active lead without follow-up date
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Open an active lead; 2. Remove follow-up date; 3. Keep lead assigned; 4. Save record
Expected_Result: System should prevent saving and display a validation message
Actual_Result: System allowed the record to exist without a follow-up date
Business_Impact: Sales executives may miss customer follow-ups, resulting in potential lead leakage
Recommended_Fix: Implement mandatory follow-up date validation for active assigned leads
Test_Evidence: Reproduced using SQL UPDATE on synthetic data; validation query detected Lead ID 1; original data restored
